Hermes Town
starting
Connect Hermes

  1. Install and enable the hermes-town-brent plugin.
  2. Run hermes town start on the Hermes host.
  3. Start a new Hermes CLI session, or restart your gateway, then run a turn.

hermes town status checks local setup and delivery.

Only lifecycle metadata. No prompts, messages, or tool output. Keep live mode local.

Appearance

Look only. Residents, places and events always come from Hermes lifecycle data; lighting, weather and motion here are decoration.

Theme

Changing the map reloads the renderer scene. Hermes and its bridge keep running; Town re-reads the current snapshot and draws the same residents. Nothing is restarted or replayed.

Environment

drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click a resident
